_comment: Every posted video and what it did. This is the ground truth Scout and The Voice calibrate against. Add rows with: node tools/post.mjs add. Rows dated before 2026-09-08 were back filled from the learning logs and content memory, so treat their numbers as recalled, not measured.

posts.lesson: Anchor win. Upward bending curve, entry zone, vibe matched. The baseline the whole two gate system was built from.
Day over day acceleration, slowed variant of a surging family. The slow atmospheric register is the constant, not the funk genre.
Win at saturation. Proof that vibe fit beats zone position. Forced the rule revision that zones price the anchor game only, they are not a gate.
Perfect curve position, wrong vibe. Bouncy sound under a slow reveal. Position never overrides vibe.
Posted into a decelerating curve. Check acceleration, not raw growth.
Hook had no stakes, the visual was buried, it died mid. Weak observational hooks do not open videos.
50s was too long, retention died around 12s. Cut to 20 to 26s. Follow CTA barely moved, needs a payoff they would miss. Like rate was fine so the content is likeable, the problem was length and grip.
